sources.recommend_reason_zh: AMD联合Spectro Cloud推出Instinct Coder 355，以8块Instinct MI355X、2颗64核EPYC 9575F、3TB内存和63.36TB存储本地跑GLM-5.3，称达前沿模型98%性能，单节点服务85名开发者、50人同时在线，默认不走云API。

en.title: AMD unveils Instinct Coder 355 local coding platform: a single machine that packs in 98% of frontier models
en.reason: AMD and Spectro Cloud's Instinct Coder 355 packs 8 MI355X GPUs, dual 64-core EPYC 9575F CPUs, 3TB memory and 63.36TB storage to run GLM-5.3 locally at a claimed 98% of frontier-model performance, serving 85 developers per node.
